integrity: Self-contained finite-field and prime-power proof, with a separate deterministic integer-arithmetic checker; finite checks are supporting rather than substitutes for infinite proof.
limitations: Exact common-divisor law is proved only for the fifth index. No conclusion is asserted at arbitrary indices; literature discovery cannot prove universal uniqueness. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Exact fifth-index common divisors of repunits and their binomial transforms
